race.comment: FIGHTER COMMAND (8) was beaten 5m as favourite in the Caduceus Classic last start but he did have to work when racing parked. Came from this row to win here prior and is up to a distance where he strikes at 50 per cent so is worth another chance. UBETCHA TIGERPIE (11) looks to be returning to form having performed well for a 1.7m second in the Caduceus Classic last start. METEOR MOTH (1) showed improvement to place from the back row last week and should get his chance from this draw. SMOKEN ACE NZ (9) cops a second line draw this time but deserves some respect off his last-start Caduceus Classic win.
